posts.author: socon
posts.body: Hey guys, I was wondering what scripts you would think are 'essential' or maybe you favorite for rpgmaker vx ace. Also if it's helps I'm making a story driven game haha.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
None
VXA can do a story-driven game as is, there is absolutely no need to get into scripting for that.
now, if you want some specific mechanics beyond "story driven", then describe them and we can make suggestions.
But make no mistake: scripts in VXA can break the engine if used wrong, there is a reason why MV/MZ switched to the plugin interface to prevent errors.
I strongly suggest you read the tutorial behind the line "how to use a script" in my signature.
If you can't handle that (including a few format mistakes due to forum updates since then), then I strongly suggest to make your first game without scripts.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
We're getting this question every now and then, and the answer is always "none". There are no "Essential" scripts that everyone should have no matter what. The scripts you implement should always only be to implement things you want/need and only that.
This whole notion of "Browsing scripts for cool features" is usually what gets you nowhere. It's better to know exactly what kind of features/mechanics you want for your game before you even open the engine.

posts.author: Zahawk
posts.body:
As Andar&SGHarlekin have pointed out, there are no essential scripts. I do however have some I frequently use if you were simply looking to browse.
Sell Only Shop by HimeWorks/Tsukihime
(Removes buy menu from shops)
Large Choices by HimeWorks/Tsukihime
(Allows more than 4 choices at once up to 11?)
Choice Options by HimeWorks/Tsukihime
(Allows choices to be edited via variables/switches)
Tile Swap by HimeWorks/Tsukihime
(Change map tiles via event command)
Scrolling Choices by Enelvon
(Allows more than 11 choices at once, [Large Choices addon])
Proximity Detection by Vlue/V.M.of D.T.
(Create events that activate based on proximity to the player)
Quest Journal by Modern Algebra
(A menu UI for info dumps Eg quests, encyclopedia, story)
Copy Event by Fomar0153+Shaz+Fluffy Dragon
(Spawn event by copying events from other maps)
Fullscreen++ by Zeus81
(A nice Fullscreen script)
Edit: "I'm making a story driven game"
I'd suggest a Message Bust script, I haven't found one I like yet though so check out the Forums and the
Master Script List

posts.author: EntangledPear
posts.body:
I agree with Zahawk, especially on the choices scripts. If your game will rely heavily on dialogue and choices, they are really useful. And I didn't know about the scrolling choices script, so your thread helped me, too
.
And while it's true that you don't want to go overboard with how many scripts you use, to avoid compatibility problems, and that you should have the basic idea of the mechanics of your game before you go script-hunting, I'd say that sometimes seeing what people came up with can inspire you to add a feature or two to make your game more interesting. I'll add
Archeia's script repository
for more scripts in one place if you want to have a look.
